entries.proposition: Design: two cycles of two three-month periods, one week washout each, 13 months in total, random order within each cycle.
entries.snippet: Each participant will undergo two cycles, each of two treatment periods. The duration of each treatment period will be three months (+1 week washout), making a total of 13 months per participant to complete the full trial.

entries.proposition: The washout is one week because of the 17-hour half-life of the amino acid, and is not used to assess effectiveness.
entries.snippet: The washout week will be added to the treatment period, and will not be used to assess effectiveness (half-life of L-serine is 17 h)

entries.proposition: The three-month period length rests on the team's own earlier case series.
entries.snippet: Previous case series conducted by our research team have proved evidence that significant alterations in the measured outcomes are reasonably expected to manifest within a three-month duration [22].

entries.proposition: A maximum of four patients because of cost restrictions.
entries.snippet: A maximum of four patients will be included due to cost restrictions.

entries.proposition: The sample size has no formal statistical basis and relies on an earlier single-patient jump from 10 to 78 percent task mastery.
entries.snippet: The sample size of four patients is based on clinical considerations and has no formal statistical basis.

entries.proposition: Detectability is conditional on very large effects.
entries.snippet: we expect that we might be able to demonstrate an effect of L-serine in this series of four patients provided that the effects are indeed very large.

entries.proposition: Blinding: participants and investigators blinded; allocation by block randomisation implemented by the hospital pharmacist.
entries.snippet: Participants and investigators will be blinded for allocation.

entries.proposition: The primary outcome is an observer-scored task-analysis of two parent-filmed everyday activities per child, scored by trained occupational therapists.
entries.snippet: Per child, 2 activities will be measured (according to the guidelines). The videos are made by the parents/caregivers using the instructions from previous research [29].

entries.proposition: Primary comparison: difference in mean PRPP score at the end of each treatment period, averaged over cycles, in a linear mixed model.
entries.snippet: The primary outcome comparison and estimate for the average treatment effect will be based on the difference in the mean PRPP-Assessment at the end of each treatment period averaged over the two cycles

entries.proposition: Only data from completed cycles will be analysed.
entries.snippet: Only data from completed cycles will be included in the analysis.

entries.proposition: Secondary outcomes include an individualised goal scale, seizure and sleep logs, resting EEG with an excitation-inhibition measure, behaviour, stool scale, quality of life.
entries.snippet: we evaluate excitation-inhibition (E/I) ratios using a functional E/I measure.

entries.proposition: Pharmacokinetic sampling of the amino acid is planned only in the open-label extension phase.
entries.snippet: blood samples for pharmacokinetics analyses will be collected at 0 (pre-dose), 60, and 150 min after L-serine ingestion during the extension phase

entries.proposition: Prior evidence for the drug in this gene is uncontrolled: non-blinded, non-randomised case studies without placebo.
entries.snippet: Previous studies on the effect of L-serine in patients with GRIN2A- and GRIN2B-related NDD are non-blinded, non-randomized case studies with no placebo [17,18,22].

entries.proposition: Although a dietary supplement, the amino acid is treated as a drug with drug regulations applying.
entries.snippet: Despite L-serine being a dietary supplement, it is considered a drug in this context.

entries.proposition: The Discussion cites n-of-1 trials as Level 1 evidence.
entries.snippet: The Oxford Centre for Evidence-Based Medicine has designated n-of-1 trials as Level 1 evidence, placing them on par with systematic reviews of RCTs [44].

entries.proposition: An open-label year after the trial lets results be analysed without withholding possible benefit.
entries.snippet: This gives patients the possibility to use L-serine for one extra year. Moreover, this enables us to analyze the results of the n-of-1 trial without withholding possible medication benefit.

entries.proposition: Fig 2: the schematic runs A, B, B, A over 12 months with outcome stars at the end of each period, a PRPP square mid-period, a baseline before and an optional open-label study to 24 months.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 2 timeline: Baseline then Cycle one periods A and B, then B and A, each three months with an orange washout block and red star at the end, grey PRPP squares at about the midpoints; Follow-up after 12 months with a purple pharmacokinetics marker; optional open-label study to 24 months.

entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Fig 1 NMDA receptor panels A and B with GluN1, GluN2A and GluN2B, glycine or D-serine sites on GluN1 and glutamate sites on GluN2.
